snippet.title: "Dash And Slash" Trailer
snippet.description:
BUY THE GAME HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951910/Dash_And_Slash/
(OR TRY THE DEMO!)

Hi my name is "spook" and I am a member of Monitor Break! This is the game I've been working sporadically on for the past 6-7 months. It's a huge relief to finally get it done, though I'm already tempted to commit to another large project (maybe in a team this time lol). I might make a devlog/retrospective on the game's development but I also probably won't.

Any support at all is hugely appreciated! :))
